kicker.zh: 型号 / 接口 / 材料

intro.en: Find a cable model or material part number, then send it for a custom replacement or original-part sourcing review.
intro.zh: 按成品型号或材料料号查找，提交编号即可沟通兼容替代件制作或原厂件采购。

search_label.en: Find a model or part number

search_placeholder.en: Brand, model, part number or product type
search_placeholder.zh: 输入品牌、型号、料号或产品类型

empty.en: No matching references. Try a brand, full part number or a listed alias.
empty.zh: 未找到匹配项，请尝试品牌、完整料号或已列出的别名。

intro.zh: Molex 原厂标准互连电缆组件。

intro.en: Molex housings, terminals, headers and seals by connector family.
intro.zh: 按系列整理的 Molex 壳体、端子、板端接头与密封件。

checks_title.en: Six Decisions Behind the Part Number
checks_title.zh: 型号背后的六个选型要点

copy.en: Confirm the exact connector family, pitch, circuit count and mating part number.
copy.zh: 确认具体连接器系列、间距、回路数与对插件编号。

copy.en: Match terminal options to conductor size, insulation diameter and the approved crimp specification.
copy.zh: 按线径、绝缘外径及确认的压接规范选择端子。

copy.en: Define pin-to-pin wiring, polarity and unused cavities on a controlled drawing.
copy.zh: 在受控图纸中定义针脚对应、极性及空置孔位。

copy.en: Set cable length datums, exit direction, latch clearance and strain relief.
copy.zh: 确定线长基准、出线方向、卡扣空间与应力释放结构。

copy.en: Check current, temperature and sealing requirements against the exact configured parts.
copy.zh: 结合实际选定零件核对电流、温度及密封要求。

copy.en: Review mating, terminal retention, continuity and sample dimensions before repeat production.
copy.zh: 批量前核对对插、端子保持力、导通及样品尺寸。

boundary.en: Send the part number, drawing or sample to confirm the replacement configuration and sourcing plan.
boundary.zh: 请提供型号、图纸或样品，具体替代配置与原厂件采购方案按项目确认。

text.en: Send the model or part number to discuss your project.
text.zh: 提交型号或料号，沟通您的定制与采购需求。

service_label.zh: 可制作兼容替代件、自有原厂采购渠道
